liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Aladdin** (2 reviews): Rashawn Ross's trumpet playing is singled out here; Reviewer especially likes the arrangement the band played of this song here [4][8]
- **Vapor** (1 review): Rashawn Ross's trumpet playing is singled out here too [4]
- **Reverb** (1 review): Kraz's guitar playing on this song gave the reviewer chills [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mellow Mood**: rare: 6 archived performances [9]
- **Slippin' Into Darkness**: rare: 11 archived performances [9]
- **Hot 2night**: rare: 3 archived performances [9]
- **Cachasa**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [9]

## The recordings

- **soulive2005-05-06.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 13 songs; 114 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Drums and hi-hat are mixed too loud, keys too quiet, and the vocals are poor [6]

## Around the show

- Toussaint sang on a Bob Marley cover [1]
- Breez Evahflowin' guested on vocals for one track [1]
- Ryan Zoidis played tenor and alto sax; Alan Evans, Eric Krasno and Rashawn Ross also sang on one song [1]
- Reviewer attended both the Thursday and Friday shows; this is the Friday one [5]
- Neil played the best organ solo the reviewer had ever heard [5]
- Reviewer found the horn parts improvised and uncertain about when to come in [6]
- Reviewer ranks it among the best shows of the tour up to that point [3]
- Reviewer downloaded eight or nine Soulive shows and rates this the best [4]
- Calls this the best Soulive lineup apart from the trio configuration [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **soulive2005-05-06.flac16**: taped by Eric Dahlgren; source: Schoeps mk4/cmc6 (DIN) > Lunatec V2 > RME/Nuendo Multiset > n-track (24 bit/44.1 khz) [1]. Also: Reviewer asks whether a 24-bit recording of this show exists and might be shared [2]
